AboutMe.title: ABOUT
AboutMe.introduction: I'm a developer who believes UI should be both beautiful and bulletproof.
AboutMe.description: I've spent nearly a decade bridging the gap between creative visualizers and systems engineers. My philosophy is simple: UI components shouldn't just look spectacular-they should be structured like clean, testable software.
AboutMe.second-description: I specialize in high-performance React architectures, design systems, and fluid pixel-perfect experiences. Whether it's standardizing a monorepo or micro-optimizing layouts, I approach frontend development as a rigorous architectural discipline.
